हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Arohi is about to get married to the love of her life Vinay, but little does she know that he is cheating on her with her best friend and has no intention to marry Arohi. She finds out about Vinay's infidelity on the day of her wedding.  Vihaan Malhotra who is compelled by his family to marry someone or else will be disinherited is present at the court house waiting for someone to get into contract marriage. Both Arohi and Vihaan cross paths
